However, since the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample released less heat, we need to find out the difference between the two values. 

The difference between 901.4 J g^−1 and 485.7 J g^−1 is 415.7 J g^−1. 

So, the 50% Mn-doped LNO sample released 415.7 J g^−1 less heat than the 10% Mn-doped LNO sample.
